title: Mint Green Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Pant Dupatta Set with Hand Work Yoke
description:
A fresh mint green 3-piece suit set in soft cotton, hand block printed by artisans in Jaipur and finished with delicate hand work on the yoke – made by Bahe Kurtiz.

The straight kurta carries rows of indigo-blue floral butis framed by fine printed borders, with larger blossom motifs near the hem. The round neckline is highlighted with hand-done thread work for a subtle festive touch. It comes with matching cotton pants with block-printed motifs at the hem, and a light, airy kota-check cotton dupatta with printed borders and tassels.

• Kurta: 100% cotton, hand block print, hand work on yoke, round neck, 3/4 sleeves, straight fit, calf length
• Pant: cotton, straight fit, block-printed hem, elastic waist
• Dupatta: kota-check cotton, hand block printed, tasselled edges
• Breathable and comfortable for long summer days
• Perfect for office, daily wear, puja, haldi & mehendi and Diwali

Each piece is hand block printed, so small variations in print and colour are part of its handmade beauty. The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
set_items: Kurta (cotton, hand block print, hand work yoke)
care: Hand block printed – first wash dry clean or gentle hand wash in cold water separately. Do not soak or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side.
